Frequently Asked Questions

Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our support team

How do I try on hairstyles online?
Using TryHair.ai is simple! First, upload a clear front-facing photo of yourself. Our AI will analyze your face shape and features, then recommend hairstyles that will look best on you. You can browse our library of 150+ styles and see instant, realistic previews of how each hairstyle would look on you.
Is TryHair.ai free to use?
Yes! New users receive 5 free virtual try-ons when they sign up. You can also earn additional free tries by inviting friends to join. For unlimited access to all features and hairstyles, we offer affordable premium membership plans starting at just $9.99 per month.
What photo formats are supported?
We currently support JPG and PNG formats. For the best results, we recommend uploading a clear, well-lit front-facing photo where your face is clearly visible. The photo should be at least 500x500 pixels, and we recommend keeping file sizes under 10MB for faster processing.
How realistic are the try-on results?
Our AI uses advanced generative technology to create highly realistic previews. The system analyzes your facial features, hair color, skin tone, and lighting conditions to blend the new hairstyle naturally onto your photo. While the results are very accurate, please note that actual haircut results may vary slightly depending on your hair texture, density, and your stylist's technique.
Do you have men's hairstyles?
Absolutely! Our collection includes 50+ men's hairstyles ranging from classic cuts like the pompadour and undercut to modern styles like textured crops, buzz cuts, and Korean-inspired looks. We regularly update our library with the latest trends from fashion capitals around the world.
How does the face shape analysis work?
Our AI face shape analysis uses computer vision technology to detect key facial landmarks and measure proportions. It identifies six main face shapes: round, square, oblong, oval, heart, and diamond. Based on your detected face shape, our system recommends hairstyles that will complement your features and enhance your natural beauty.
Is my privacy protected?
Your privacy is our top priority. Photos you upload are processed securely using encrypted connections and are never shared with third parties. We use your photos solely for generating hairstyle previews and face shape analysis. You can delete your photos and account data at any time. We comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other international data protection regulations.
Can I save and share my try-on results?
Yes! You can save unlimited try-on results to your personal gallery and download them as high-quality images. Share your favorite looks directly to social media platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, or send them to your friends and hairstylist for feedback.
What devices and browsers are supported?
TryHair.ai works on all modern devices including desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones. We support the latest versions of Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge browsers. For the best experience, we recommend using a device with a screen size of at least 768px. No app download is required.
How often are new hairstyles added?
We update our hairstyle library monthly with the latest trends from fashion weeks in New York, London, Paris, Milan, Seoul, and Tokyo. Our team of professional hairstylists and trend forecasters curate each addition to ensure we offer the most current and stylish options.
Can I get personalized hairstyle recommendations?
Yes! Our AI provides personalized recommendations based on multiple factors: your face shape, hair type (straight, wavy, curly, coily), lifestyle preferences, and current trends. Simply complete a short questionnaire about your preferences, and our system will curate a selection of hairstyles perfectly suited to you.
